parameters.query:
WITH sp AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS hoje),
per AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month',(SELECT hoje FROM sp))::date - interval '1 month' AS ini,
         date_trunc('month',(SELECT hoje FROM sp))::date AS fim,
         date_trunc('month',(SELECT hoje FROM sp))::date - interval '2 month' AS ini_ant
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'mes', to_char((SELECT ini FROM per),'YYYY-MM'),
  'receita', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(valor),0) FROM financas_lancamentos,per WHERE classe='receita' AND data_lancamento>=per.ini AND data_lancamento<per.fim),
  'despesa', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(valor),0) FROM financas_lancamentos,per WHERE classe='despesa' AND data_lancamento>=per.ini AND data_lancamento<per.fim),
  'despesa_ant', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(valor),0) FROM financas_lancamentos,per WHERE classe='despesa' AND data_lancamento>=per.ini_ant AND data_lancamento<per.ini),
  'aporte', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(valor),0) FROM financas_lancamentos,per WHERE classe='aporte' AND data_lancamento>=per.ini AND data_lancamento<per.fim),
  'top_cat', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(x),'[]') FROM (SELECT COALESCE(categoria,'Outros') AS categoria, SUM(valor) AS total FROM financas_lancamentos,per WHERE classe='despesa' AND data_lancamento>=per.ini AND data_lancamento<per.fim GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5) x),
  'maior', (SELECT json_build_object('descricao',COALESCE(descricao,'—'),'valor',valor) FROM financas_lancamentos,per WHERE classe='despesa' AND data_lancamento>=per.ini AND data_lancamento<per.fim ORDER BY valor DESC LIMIT 1)
) AS resumo;
